title: Node
description: One node instance in a task's artifact graph (docs/design/m0/13 "Model"): a decision with declared, typed inputs. The graph is append-only: a node's inputs never change once it is recorded, and new information creates a successor node (13 "Successor rounds"). A node's task and its predecessor are carried by the graph events that record it (G3, G5, G6b), never as fields here. Node kinds are Go code (13 "v1 scope"); internal/graph checks each kind's params and that input names are unique.

definition_version.description: The version of the kind's definition. A change is an explicit invalidation (13 [G1]).

inputs.description: Ordered, and the order is part of the kind's definition: two instances of a kind list the same inputs in the same order. The computation key hashes the resolved input ids either in this order or sorted by name; G2 fixes which.

params.description: The kind's parameters, one schema per kind (a review's params carry its roster, 13). Their digest is part of the computation key. G2 computes it only after a bounded strict read (internal/contract ReadStrict: integers within ±(2^53−1)), through the eventstore canonicaliser, and refuses anything outside that range.

requires.description: What the node leases to run (05). A controller node has no role and no capability. That a model kind has both is internal/graph's check, not the schema's.

capability.description: The capability profile the executor must offer (09).

resources.description: The kinds of resource group a lease reserves from.

effect.description: The effect kind, run under a durable effect identity (03 "External effects"). null is the only way to say none. A merge node's is merge and a deploy node's deploy; a record node's is notification or null; every other kind has none. A cached effect result is history, never current state (13 [G4]).

round.description: The successor index: 1 for the first instance, and the predecessor's round plus one for each successor (repair, answers, new demands). Rails count across rounds.
